scope: Review of the host_sampling compatibility repair only. No model or TT execution performed; frozen rereview and root admission were not changed.

forced_history_and_logits.verdict: repair preserves the diagnostic's forced-history semantics at the inspected source-contract level
evidence: actual_branch_logits.py:247-263 validates greedy compatibility parameters, reads generator.logits to host before the callback returns the exact saved branch token, and checks the expected captured row count.

generator.py:343-438 stores the terminal prefill model logits in self.logits and runs the existing sampler trace; generate() then reads raw self.logits argmax in host mode and invokes next_input, whose return is copied into the next input token (generator.py:706-723). Thus the sampler-selected prefill token is discarded when the callback supplies the branch token.

generator.py:568-575 executes the model trace and returns self.logits directly in host_sampling mode without executing sample_trace; generator.py:725-735 then captures the row and forces the saved branch token for the next model replay.

generator.py:148-154 copies model.decode logits into self.logits. The inspected sampler force-argmax path assigns transformed/gathered values to local x variables and writes token indices to tt_out_tok; it does not overwrite the generator's logits buffer.
forced_history_and_logits.qualification: Prefill still performs one greedy sampler replay per branch call before the callback replaces its selected token. The diagnostic records forced-history model logits, not stochastic sampled histories or a canonical sampler replay.
